* Add and tune observability \- Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, Alertmanager rules

* Learn to recognize common failure modes (IP exhaustion, resource limits, reconciliation lag) and escalate them early

* ArgoCD, GitLab CI/CD, Nexus (artifact registry), Docker, container image build pipelines
